message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that turned into a cozy little adventure. With our flashlights and power banks ready, we gathered in the living room, and instead of scrolling through screens, we dusted off some board games. Who knew a little low-tech fun could bring us all together like that? I even made some popcorn on the camping stove! Have you had a similar experience during a power outage? What’s your go-to activity when the lights go out? 🌟
